methodology.hardware: one NVIDIA GB200 per run (184.31 GiB)
methodology.timing: CUDA events around full model+loss forward, loss.backward, and complete GPU optimizer step; synchronized once per step
methodology.scope_note: B1-B3 execute all 32 Llama 3 8B layers. B4 executes the complete DeepSeek-V3 2A600M MoE proxy; it is not the production 27A4B EP=8 model.
